_note: Public marketing copy only, written from each app's own README/docs. Do not add ports, paths, hosting or vendor internals. published:false keeps a product off the site (ClaudeOS is internal).

products.name: CRM
products.headline: Know every customer. Close every deal.
products.summary: A modern customer relationship manager for small sales and support teams: contacts, companies, deals and tasks in one place.
products.audience: Sales and support teams, agencies, and any business that lives on customer relationships.
features: Searchable, filterable records with a full activity timeline for each.
A drag-and-drop board, with a recorded reason when a deal is lost.
Open, overdue and completed views, plus a log of calls, emails, meetings and notes.
Pipeline value, recent wins, win rate and what needs attention today.
Admin, sales and support roles, two-step verification and a full audit log.
A documented REST API so it can connect to your other tools.
benefits: Easy to learn, with light and dark themes
Built for teams that outgrow spreadsheets

products.name: Remote Management
products.headline: Keep every device healthy, from one screen.
products.summary: Remote monitoring and management for IT providers and in-house IT: monitor devices, patch them, respond to alerts and support users.
products.audience: Managed service providers and IT teams responsible for many computers.
features: Real-time CPU, memory and disk health across Windows, macOS and Linux.
Threshold and offline rules, with email, Slack and Teams notifications.
See and apply operating-system updates across your fleet.
Run maintenance scripts remotely, on demand or on a schedule.
Priorities, assignees and SLA targets in the same console.
Compliance reports and recurring invoices based on device count.
benefits: One console instead of several tools

products.name: RECI Transport
products.headline: Car rental, booked and managed online.
products.summary: A rental portal for car hire businesses: customers browse and book online, and your team manages the fleet and bookings from an admin portal.
products.audience: Car rental companies and small fleet operators.
features: A customer-facing site where drivers browse vehicles and reserve them.
Staff manage vehicles, bookings and users, with role-based access.
Card payments handled through a trusted payment provider.
Driver licence verification as part of the booking flow.
Helps customers with questions about vehicles and bookings.
Booking confirmations and updates sent for you.
benefits: Prices calculated on the server, never by the customer
Customer and staff areas kept separate

products.name: Airfinder
products.headline: Find the cheapest way to fly.
products.summary: A flight search and booking platform for travel agencies and resellers, with search by plain-language request and a staff portal.
products.audience: Travel agencies, resellers and anyone selling flights online.
features: Search by route and date, including multi-city trips.
Type what you want, such as a destination and a budget, instead of filling forms.
Roles for admin, agent and finance, with an overview and revenue summary.
Set your own markup, service fee and commission.
A shareable status page for any flight number and date.
benefits: Separate roles for agents and finance
Runs as its own branded site

products.name: Image Optimizer
products.headline: Smaller images. Same sharp look.
products.summary: Upload an image and tune its quality, format and size, with a live preview. Every change starts from your original, so quality never degrades.
products.audience: Website owners, designers, shops and anyone who publishes images.
features: Adjust compression and convert between formats.
Resize precisely or crop by dragging.
Brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, sharpen, blur and grayscale.
Process many images in one go.
Uploads are temporary and cleared automatically after a short time.
benefits: Never re-compresses an already compressed result
No account needed to try it
